title: The mailbox, 2024
logline: Christmas Eve. The mailbox, flag down — and this year a card inside, the flap open, the card's edge showing. The page doesn't take it out. Whether she comes: reserved. The card is enough.

margin.note: The crab, small, beside the word.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox at dusk, flag down, the door open, and inside, the pale edge of a card in an envelope. Rain on the metal. A porch light far back. The page leaves the card where it is.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox at dusk with its flag down and its door open showing the pale edge of an envelope inside, rain on the metal, a distant porch light, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
